title: Explicit per-solve reference Richards physical-state binding
goal: Remove whole-solve request/candidate physical-state translation through shared legacy module globals from the admitted common reference solver path while preserving the legacy standalone compatibility path and all qualified Richards formulas and numerical semantics.

headcalc_contract.signature_target: headcalc(worker, fsi_workspace, history, state_binding, evaluation_context, boundary_conditions)
headcalc_contract.legacy_no_state_argument_behavior: capture legacy mutable state into call-local binding, run identical HeadCalc formulas, publish binding back before return
headcalc_contract.newton_iteration_carrier: local solver_numbit synchronized to state%numbit without changing MaxIt1 or convergence semantics

provider_boundary.real_headcalc_parallel_reentrancy_scope: focused admitted reference fixture: swmacro=0, swkimpl=0, fldtmin=false, free-drainage bottom mode, explicit flux top provider, fixed shared legacy constitutive/source-sink fixture; main and forced-band routes; O0/O2; 1/2/4/8 workers
provider_boundary.parallel_reference_backend_hold_reason: The F-SI07 tests prove per-solve physical-state and explicit top-boundary isolation, including real common-route 1/2/4/8 identity, but production constitutive hydraulics and source/sink/drainage/irrigation providers still read legacy shared module data. Heterogeneous per-column provider parameterization is therefore not yet source-bound as reentrant, so general parallel backend admission remains fail closed.

qualification_required: explicit-state HeadCalc compiles at O0 and O2
exact F-SI06 preimage versus F-SI07 serial real common-route identity at O0 and O2
main and forced band fallback identity
explicit state binding A/B/A order independence on focused fixture
scratch poisoning and state/global sentinel isolation
request objects remain unmodified by solve
common adapter contains no whole-solve physical-state global overlay or physical/reconstructible global reads in solve
common adapter result is sourced from explicit state binding
missing explicit top provider fails closed before HeadCalc
real admitted common route is deterministic against serial reference for 1, 2, 4 and 8 workers at O0 and O2
changed SoilWater HeadCalc interface compiles at O0 and O2
F-KT transaction and worker boundary regressions remain green
